name: ez-actions
title: EZ Actions
author: mtopfox
description: A radial menu for anything you do often (port of the Minecraft mod EZ Actions by z2six). Hold U, flick the mouse toward a slice, let go. Slices fire any of the game's controls or another mod's keybind, a shortcut-bar shortcut, a direct hotkey, chat commands, or equip a saved loadout. Nested bundles with their own keys, an in-game editor, import/export, and a remote API. Controls, hotkeys and commands need the FSE loader.
